Indonesia's Bali Faces Fuel Shortages, Long Queues at Stations

Indonesia's resort island of Bali experienced significant fuel shortages starting Wednesday, October 14, leading to hours-long queues at petrol stations. Disrupted fuel deliveries caused motorists to wait for extended periods, with the crisis impacting the island for several days. Similar fuel shortages were reported in Malawi, where motorists were sleeping at petrol stations.
